page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a full-width heading above it. Page number top left, running head "HABAKUK" top centre. Section headings IX and X are centred. The division rule sits between the two sections. No margin notes.

main_text.head: IX. Ejusdem prophetiæ argumentum.
main_text.p: 1. PRo duplici exspectatione regni Christi, vel ut introducendi cum adductione salutis & uberio-ris gratiæ dispensatione, vel ut post multa certamina promovendi ad summum authoritatis culmen per subje-ctionem mundi & subactionem hostium, pertractantur hic viæ Dei, cum ante Christi adventum in carnem, tum post eam servandæ.

2. Respectu prioris temporis exponitur consilium Dei de repurgandâ ecclesiâ Judaicâ per judicium populo corruptissimo imminens & per Chaldæos infligendum, cum hoc tamen rerum eventu, ut velit justus Judex tandem castigationis suæ instrumentum confringi, & reliquias populi exploratas libertati restitui, atque in sta-tu restituto conservari, donec Christus veniat, & adductam justitiam & salutem denuncier.

3. Respectu posterioris temporis docet in hac causâ errantes, regnum Christi quoque habiturum suas adversitates & oppugnationes, verum Dei manu ita coercen-das & subigendas, ut os obloquentium & sese veritati opponentium ad plenariam ἐχεμυθίαν[?] tandem redigatur, & ecclesia triumphis gloriosior sub tutelâ regis ultimâ tranquillitate fruatur.
main_text.head: X. Divisio generalis.
main_text.p: HÆc prophetia, quam præsens hoc opusculum exponit, duabus absolvitur partibus; occurrit enim in hoc libro
main_text.l: I. Dialogismus prophetam inter & Deum, exhibens

page.notes: Small star-like marks stand in the right margin beside "redigatur," and "fruatur." They look like printer's ornaments or signs, not text, so they are left out. The Greek word ἐχεμυθίαν is uncertain; the Greek is marked [?]. The first line of the page is a fresh heading, so no continuation paragraph is needed.
